newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile cenbank revises 1997 trade deficit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Chile cenbank revises 1997 trade deficit forecast.

text.p: Chile's Central Bank has revised its forecast of this year's trade deficit to $900 million from $950 million originally estimated in September, said president Carlos Massad.
The reduction is " as a result of a higher level of exports than those budgeted in the report to the senate presented last September," Massad told reporters.
Chile posted a $1.26 billion trade deficit last year.
The bank estimates that investment will be equivalent to 28.5 percent of the gross domestic product this year, he said.
